newsitem.title: CHINA: Road King issue upped to US$140 mln.
newsitem.headline: Road King issue upped to US$140 mln.

text.p: Road King Infrastructure Ltd's issue of US$100 million notes due 2007 has been increased to US$140 million, arrangers said on Thursday.
They said the deal was completed in New York this week, with investors showing strong interest in the paper.
It was issued at 99.423 with a 9.5 percent coupon to yield 9.591 percent, 312.5 basis points over the 10-year U.S. Treasury at the time of the launch.
Proceeds of the issue, arranged by Peregrine Fixed Income, would be used for general corporate purposes, particularly for future investment opportunities in China.
Road King, a spinoff of engineering group Wai Kee Holdings Ltd, is a toll road investor and operator in China.
